prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.9 °C (67% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.4 °C (57% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.9 °C (49% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.99 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.8 bar (within 2% of healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
